{"id":2064392073,"question_id":4357,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 week, 4 days","timestamp":1783823730,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"1 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2064392073/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Number of Elapsed Seconds Between Two Times","memory":"10.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int convert(string t){\n        int h = stoi(t.substr(0,2));\n        int m = stoi(t.substr(3,2));\n        int s = stoi(t.substr(6,2));\n\n        return h* 3600 + m *60 + s;\n    }\n    int secondsBetweenTimes(string startTime, string endTime) {\n        int start = convert(startTime);\n        int end = convert(endTime);\n\n        return end - start;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"number-of-elapsed-seconds-between-two-times","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2316}
